tag: 濕地保護區導覽行程更正

level.why: 行程表與口頭更正需對照，資訊密集，含圖表題與推論題

script.t: Good morning, nature lovers, and welcome to our guided walk through Heron Marsh Wetland.
script.zh: 早安，熱愛自然的朋友們，歡迎參加蒼鷺沼澤濕地的導覽步行。

script.t: My name is Leo, and I have worked here as a ranger for eight years.
script.zh: 我是李奧，我在這裡當了八年的巡護員。

script.t: We will start at the Visitor Center, where I will hand out binoculars.
script.zh: 我們從遊客中心出發，我會在那裡發望遠鏡。

script.t: At nine thirty, we will climb the bird tower, which has the best view of the marsh.
script.zh: 九點半我們會登上賞鳥塔，那裡是欣賞沼澤的最佳位置。

script.t: Your schedule shows a walk along the boardwalk at a quarter past ten.
script.zh: 你們的行程表顯示十點十五分要走木棧道。

script.t: Unfortunately, last night's rain flooded that part, so it is closed until next week.
script.zh: 很遺憾，昨晚的雨淹了那一段，所以到下週前都封閉。

script.t: Instead, we will visit the pond garden at that time, and we will stay there for forty-five minutes.
script.zh: 我們改在那個時間參觀池塘花園，並在那裡待四十五分鐘。

script.t: The garden is full of frogs, so please walk quietly and stay on the gravel path.
script.zh: 花園裡有很多青蛙，所以請輕聲行走並留在碎石小徑上。

script.t: We will end back at the Visitor Center at eleven thirty, a bit earlier than planned.
script.zh: 我們十一點半回到遊客中心結束，比原訂時間早一些。

script.t: Please don't feed any animals, because it harms their health.
script.zh: 請不要餵食任何動物，因為這會傷害牠們的健康。

script.t: If you see something interesting, raise your hand, and I will gladly stop the group.
script.zh: 如果看到有趣的東西，請舉手，我很樂意讓大家停下來。

script.t: Alright, let's begin our walk.
script.zh: 好，我們開始走吧。

q.t: Look at the graphic. Which stop will the group visit at 10:15?
q.zh: 請看圖表。團體在10:15會參觀哪一站？

choices.why: 木棧道封閉，改在該時間參觀池塘花園。
這是講義上的原定行程，但已因淹水封閉。
賞鳥塔是9:30的行程。
遊客中心是出發與結束地點，不是10:15的行程。

q.t: How long will the group stay at the pond garden?
q.zh: 團體會在池塘花園停留多久？

choices.why: 原文 forty-five minutes。
十五分是行程時間（十點十五）的一部分。
三十分是賞鳥塔與結束的時間點。
八是講者擔任巡護員的年數。

q.t: Why does the speaker ask visitors to walk quietly in the garden?
q.zh: 說話者為什麼要求遊客在花園裡輕聲行走？

choices.why: 花園裡有很多青蛙，所以請輕聲。

choices.zh: 附近有另一團正在睡覺。
choices.why: 獨白沒有提到其他團體。

choices.t: The speaker has a sore throat.
choices.why: 獨白沒有提到身體不適。

choices.t: The path is closed to the public.
choices.why: 遊客可以走在碎石小徑上。

tag: 湖濱路跑起跑時間更正廣播

level.why: 先說北入口七點再更正為南入口七點半，含意圖題與未來行動題

script.t: Attention, runners, this is an important notice from the organizers of the Lakeshore Fun Run.
script.zh: 跑者請注意，這是湖濱趣味路跑主辦單位的重要通知。

script.t: Last week, we told you that the race would start at seven a.m. at the north entrance.
script.zh: 上週我們告訴大家，比賽會在早上七點於北入口起跑。

script.t: Because of road work, the start line has moved to the south entrance, near the boat house.
script.zh: 因為道路施工，起跑線已移到靠近船屋的南入口。

script.t: The start time has also changed, and it is now seven thirty.
script.zh: 起跑時間也有更動，現在是七點半。

script.t: I understand that this is a late change, but it is the only safe option.
script.zh: 我知道這是臨時的更動，但這是唯一安全的選擇。

script.t: Free buses will run from the main parking lot every ten minutes.
script.zh: 免費巴士會從主停車場每十分鐘發一班。

script.t: Registration closes at six forty-five, so please don't wait until the last minute.
script.zh: 報名在六點四十五分截止，所以請不要等到最後一刻。

script.t: Runners who have already picked up their numbers do not need to register again.
script.zh: 已領取號碼布的跑者不需要再報名。

script.t: The finish line is still at the central fountain.
script.zh: 終點線仍在中央噴水池。

script.t: Water stations will be set up every two kilometers along the course.
script.zh: 沿著賽道每兩公里會設置補水站。

script.t: We apologize for the trouble, and we hope to see you at the starting line.
script.zh: 對於造成的不便我們深感抱歉，期待在起跑線上見到大家。

q.t: What is the purpose of the announcement?
q.zh: 這則廣播的目的是什麼？

choices.t: To inform runners about race changes
choices.why: 起跑地點與時間都有更動。
比賽尚未開始，沒有成績。
比賽仍會舉行，只是更動起跑安排。
獨白沒有招募志工。

q.t: What does the speaker mean when she says, "I understand that this is a late change, but it is the only safe option"?
q.zh: 說話者說「I understand that this is a late change, but it is the only safe option」是什麼意思？

choices.t: She is explaining why the change cannot be avoided.
choices.zh: 她在解釋為何無法避免這項更動。
choices.why: 承認更動太晚，但說明這是唯一安全的做法。

choices.t: She is asking runners to cancel.
choices.why: 她期待在起跑線見到大家。

choices.t: She plans to change the start again.
choices.zh: 她打算再次更改起跑安排。
choices.why: 獨白沒有這個意思。

choices.t: She is blaming the runners for the delay.
choices.zh: 她把延誤怪在跑者身上。
choices.why: 原因是道路施工。

q.t: What are runners who have not picked up their numbers asked to do?
q.zh: 尚未領取號碼布的跑者被要求做什麼？

choices.zh: 在六點四十五分前報名
choices.why: Registration closes at six forty-five。
起跑位置已改到南入口。
重新報名是針對已領號碼的人說「不需要」。
噴水池是終點線位置。

tag: 公園植樹志工感謝致詞

level.why: 先說目標五百棵再說實際六百二十棵，含身份題與意圖題

script.t: Thank you, volunteers, for giving up your Saturday morning to help our park.
script.zh: 謝謝各位志工，犧牲週六早晨來幫助我們的公園。

script.t: I am Daniel Reyes, and I have the honor of leading the city's Parks Department.
script.zh: 我是丹尼爾·雷耶斯，很榮幸帶領市公園處。

script.t: When we started this project, our goal was to plant five hundred saplings.
script.zh: 我們開始這項計畫時，目標是種下五百棵樹苗。

script.t: Today I am proud to say that you have planted six hundred and twenty.
script.zh: 今天我很驕傲地說，你們種下了六百二十棵。

script.t: Of course, planting is only the first step, and the young trees need care for several years.
script.zh: 當然，種樹只是第一步，幼樹需要照顧好幾年。

script.t: That is why we are starting a watering group, which will meet every Sunday morning.
script.zh: 因此我們要成立澆水小組，每週日早上集合。

script.t: Anyone can join, but we especially need people who live near the park.
script.zh: 任何人都可以加入，但我們特別需要住在公園附近的人。

script.t: Our biggest supporter, Green Valley Bank, paid for all the tools you used today.
script.zh: 我們最大的支持者綠谷銀行，支付了你們今天使用的所有工具。

script.t: I would also like to thank the students from Hillside High School, who arrived before sunrise.
script.zh: 我也要感謝山坡高中的學生，他們在日出前就到了。

script.t: In ten years, this land will be a shady forest where families can rest.
script.zh: 十年後，這片土地將成為家庭可以休息的蔭涼森林。

script.t: Now please enjoy the lunch waiting for you under the big tent.
script.zh: 現在請享用大帳篷下為你們準備的午餐。

script.t: Thank you once again, and enjoy the rest of your day.
script.zh: 再次謝謝大家，祝您有美好的一天。

q.t: Who is the speaker mainly addressing?
q.zh: 說話者主要是在對誰說話？

choices.why: 開頭就感謝 volunteers。
銀行只是被感謝的贊助者。
公園處是說話者領導的單位，不是聽眾。
被提到的是學生，不是老師。

q.t: How many saplings did the group plant?
q.zh: 這個團體種下了多少棵樹苗？

choices.why: you have planted six hundred and twenty。
這是原本的目標。
獨白說的是六百二十棵。
十是指十年後。

q.t: What does the speaker imply when he says, "Of course, planting is only the first step"?
q.zh: 說話者說「Of course, planting is only the first step」是暗示什麼？

choices.t: The trees will need continued care.
choices.why: 接著說幼樹需要照顧好幾年。
他說種樹只是第一步，後面還有工作。
獨白沒有這種暗示。

choices.t: The volunteers should plant more today.
choices.zh: 志工今天該再多種一些。
choices.why: 他請大家享用午餐，沒有要求再種。
